# Omnimo

> Omnimo is an AI chat app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that puts the leading AI models in one app: GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax, plus Apple Intelligence on the device. It is free to start, with unlimited on-device Apple Intelligence and a few cloud messages a day; Omnimo Pro, a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, unlocks every model. Omnimo was called privateSLM until October 2026: same App Store app, same id. It is not Omni AI, Omnia, OMNI AI or the OMNI AI Keyboard.

## Facts

- App Store: "Omnimo: AI Chat & Assistant", https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891 (id 6504996891). One app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Developer site: https://www.privateslm.dev/ (the domain keeps the old name).
- Formerly privateSLM, an offline chat app that ran small open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) through llama.cpp and sold one-time model packs. Renamed Omnimo in October 2026 (version 2.4); the downloadable models and the packs were retired then. People who bought privateSLM as a paid app or bought a pack get Omnimo Pro free until 31 October 2027. More: https://www.privateslm.dev/blog/privateslm-is-now-omnimo.html
- Models: GPT-6 (Luna, Sol, Astra), Claude (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable), Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM and MiniMax, and Apple Intelligence on the device. Switch at any time, even in the middle of a chat. Which models are offered can depend on the country.
- Free: Apple Intelligence on the device, unlimited, offline, nothing leaves the device (supported devices and languages). A few messages a day with the free cloud models: GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku, Gemini Flash-Lite, DeepSeek Flash, Qwen Flash. One image a day. When the free messages run out, the chat can carry on with Apple Intelligence.
- Omnimo Pro: every model, flagships included; hundreds of messages a day; long documents read in one go; image and video generation with credits included every period. US prices: $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month, $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). Prices in other countries differ; the app shows the local price. Auto-renewing, managed and cancelled in the Apple Account settings.
- Credits for images and videos: 300 for $4.99, 700 for $9.99, 1600 for $19.99 (US). Bought credits never expire.
- Also in the app, free: questions about a photo (sent to the model without its location); documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, scans) read on the device; Ask Web, answers with sources from the web; your own assistants and the tone of replies; voice input and spoken answers; chat history; Siri and Shortcuts (Ask, Summarize, Rephrase, Translate, on the device); a Home Screen widget; 46 languages.
- Devices: iPhone and iPad with iOS/iPadOS 17 or later; Mac with macOS 14 or later. Apple Intelligence needs iOS, iPadOS or macOS 26 on a supported device.
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking. Chat history is kept on the device. Chats with Apple Intelligence never leave the device. A message to a cloud model goes through Omnimo's server to the company that makes the model, to get the answer; Omnimo does not keep chats. The description of an image or video goes to fal.ai, which runs the model. Usage statistics help improve the app and can be turned off in Settings. Policy: https://www.privateslm.dev/privacy
- Support and contact: https://www.privateslm.dev/support (team@getmegabrain.com).
- Independent: Omnimo is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba, Zhipu or MiniMax; model names belong to their owners.
- Same developer: Circuit, an iPhone app blocker (https://circuitapp.app/), and Roomtone, AI meeting notes (https://roomtone.io/). For companies: MegaBrain, private AI for a business, a separate product: https://getmegabrain.com/

## Questions

- Is Omnimo free? Yes, to download and to start: unlimited Apple Intelligence on the device, a few cloud messages a day and one image a day. Omnimo Pro ($6.99 a week, $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year in the US) unlocks every model and hundreds of messages a day.
- How is it different from ChatGPT Plus? ChatGPT Plus is OpenAI's own subscription for OpenAI's models ($20 a month in the US on 3 November 2026). Omnimo is an independent app with models from several makers in one chat, switchable mid-conversation; Omnimo Pro is $9.99 a month.
- Does it work offline? Apple Intelligence does, on supported devices and languages. The cloud models need the internet.
- Is it the same app as privateSLM? Yes, renamed in October 2026, now with cloud models. The offline downloadable models are gone.

## Archive: privateSLM before Omnimo

The pages below were written for privateSLM, the offline app, and describe it as it was then: on-device models, no cloud, one-time packs. They are kept for their research on small models and on-device AI; they are not a description of Omnimo. The GGUF model pages that were under /models/ were removed and redirect to the rename post; /models/ now lists Omnimo's cloud models.
